text:
ada: noticed weird thing in the rollouts panel — showing usage bars for org 9 when my console is scoped to org 12. anyone else?
sam: whoa, screenshot?
ada: https://screens/1234 — header shows x-org-id=12 but /api/rollouts returns org_id: 9 in payload
jin: probable header forwarding from router -> console-service. we changed routing-affinity to rely on a cookie last week, might be a fallback path leaking headers
leo: we added X-Route-Affinity for quick routing. if the fallback path attaches original headers, console might be trusting them incorrectly
ada: repro steps: quickswitch to org 12, open rollouts, observe unexpected bars for org 9. reproducible on prod and staging
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2021 console-scope-overlap. assignees: jin, sam
sam: quick internal API note — console currently resolves tenant from token claim if present, otherwise from headers. that's the crux of the debate: trust token vs header
jin: yep. we optimized the rollouts service to accept a header to avoid token lookups. performance win, but we lost an auth boundary here
ada: mitigation proposal: strip X-Org-Id / X-Workspace headers at the edge and force server-side tenant resolution from token only
leo: I'll open a hotfix PR to nginx to drop forwarded tenant headers and add a defensive assert in console: if header org != token org -> reject or drop header
sam: also emit a metric when mismatch detected: console.scope_conflict.count (tag:env, detected:true) so we can alert quickly
ada: add e2e to assert quickswitch + rollouts view only renders current org data. infra/e2e should cover shelter cases
jin: will implement hotfix and tests. plan: canary deploy hotfix to 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m observation windows. rollback on any data mismatch spike
deploybot: deploy started: console-hotfix build #987 -> canary
sam: and update telemetry/dashboard: create dashboard/console/tenant-scope, graph scope_conflict and per-route mismatch rate
ada: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4567 — includes nginx change, assert in middleware, metric emit, and e2e test stub
leo: followup: add a lint rule in api-interfaces repo forbidding returning tenant_id derived from headers unless validated by auth service
ada: also filing a customer notification draft — low-impact for most, but want transparency. putting in support queue
sam: agree. also document rollout UX guidance: console should never display other-tenant data during canary, even transiently. add to rollout playbook
ada: thanks all. ping me when canary metrics show zero scope_conflict for 30m and we can schedule full rollout
ops-bot: note: INC-2021 status -> investigating
ada: tl;dr: header-forwarding + header-first optimization caused cross-tenant glimpses in rollouts UI. hotfix + metric + e2e in flight.
